description: Sends the signed-in person's question or problem to Autonomad and returns the answer in the same call. `reply` is the answer from Autonomad's automated responder, which can use the person's own flight, hotel and experience details; it is saved in their Autonomad thread. If it cannot be answered automatically, or needs_person is true, a support ticket is opened instead and `what_happens_next` states what is pending; repeat that without adding a reply time or a promise that a person will respond. A tool error means the message was not answered. This tool does not change bookings: to cancel, rebook or change one, use preview_booking_change first. Do not include card numbers, passwords or one-time codes.

needs_person.description: true only when the person asks for a human, or the instant answer did not solve it: opens a support ticket instead of answering automatically.

text.description: The question or problem, in the person's words where possible. Up to 4000 characters.

name: message_autonomad
